payload.description: Implemented autonomous PR merging for Copilot-created PRs to enable zero-approval execution flow
changes: Created auto-merge-copilot.yml workflow with triggers for PR and check_suite events
Implemented PR eligibility checks: copilot author, copilot-agent label, or copilot/ branch prefix
Added draft PR and [no-auto-merge] flag filtering
Integrated check waiting logic: monitors lint, build, test checks for up to 30 minutes
Configured auto-approve and auto-merge with squash strategy upon check passage
Added notification system with status comments at each stage
Created auto-merge-config.yml with customizable settings for merge method, required checks, timeouts
verification: Workflow syntax validated against existing auto-merge patterns
Uses actions/github-script@v7 for GitHub API interactions
gh CLI commands for PR approval and merge enablement
Follows existing repository patterns from auto-merge.yml and auto-merge-all-prs.yml
Permissions set: contents: write, pull-requests: write, checks: read
payload.impact: Enables @bickfordd-bit to set intent once and receive updates without blocking approval gates. Copilot PRs auto-merge when checks pass.
safety_guards: Only triggers for Copilot PRs (author, labels, or branch pattern match)
Requires all checks (lint, build, test) to pass before merge
Uses squash merge strategy to keep history clean
Respects [no-auto-merge] opt-out flag in PR title
testing_instructions: Create a PR from branch with copilot/ prefix or copilot-agent label
Verify workflow triggers and posts status comment
Confirm auto-merge enables when PR checks pass
Validate notification comments appear at each stage
Test opt-out by adding [no-auto-merge] to title
